description: A grassroots coalition of municipal IT teams, bio labs, and open-source AI developers across Germany, Belgium, and northern Italy spontaneously forms a distributed incident response network, using shared lightweight models to detect and patch local AI-driven threats in real time. It emerges from the fragmentation of EU cyber resilience and the lack of central trust, becoming a de facto standard in regions skeptical of Brussels. The network is informal but effective, and its existence pressures ENISA to integrate it.
